summary: Maps an event parameter a3 to a bucket index written to a1+8, plus a secondary value from sub_414180(a2) written to a1+12. Dispatch mode a2 selects one of two switch jump tables (a2=0 via jpt_412E78 covering cases 1-26; a2=1 via jpt_413097 covering cases 1-24); each case selects a base value that the flag a4 adjusts to one of two variants. Special cases a3=23 (a2=1) and a3=26 (a2=0) compute the index as (a4 != 0 ? 0xFFFFFFE8 : 0) + 265. On a valid mapping writes both fields and returns 1; invalid a2 or a3 returns -1. Called from RaceEventMessageDispatcher and SoundEventDispatcher.

Guard on a2: only a2 == 0 or a2 == 1 enter a switch; any other value returns -1 immediately.

Dispatch on a3 through the a2==1 jump table jpt_413097 (cases 1-24).
Each ordinary case selects a bucket-index base; the flag a4 picks one of two variants (a4 != 0 selects the lower base, otherwise the base is offset by 24 for a2==1 or 26 for a2==0).
Special cases a3=23 (a2==1) and a3=26 (a2==0) compute v5 = (a4 != 0 ? 0xFFFFFFE8 : 0) + 265.
Guard on the computed index v5 >= 0; a negative index leaves result at -1 without writing.
Write the mapped bucket index v5 to a1+8.
Write the secondary value returned by sub_414180(a2) to a1+12.
Return 1 on success, -1 on invalid a2/a3 or negative index.
